visualCharacteristics.purpose: horizontal carousel of large grey-background product tiles (image, name, rating, price), usually placed beside an intro in a split section
notes: Large grey-background product image tiles with name, rating and price below, scrolling beside an intro (split).

Split layout: narrow left intro (heading, offer text, No Cost EMI note with asterisk icon, black pill View All button) beside a horizontally scrolling carousel of large grey product tiles (image, name, star rating, price).
Same large grey product tile carousel as s4-q2.
Split layout like s4: left "Super OFFERS" logo image, heading, text, black View All pill; right carousel of large grey product tiles.

contentPattern.structure: one row per product; cell 1: product image; cell 2: product name link, rating, price (strike the MRP with del) and discount as paragraphs
cells: Text: optional heading/title, description, CTA link
reasons: Product list linking to product detail pages (/p/...) with price, MRP, discount, rating and badges; dynamic merchandised list (1,000+ cards in the DOM across tabs/carousels, counts vary). Author representative content only: the cards visible on load (about 4-8 per list), not every hidden item.

usage: Merchandised product carousels (Best of Apple, Super Offers). Put the intro heading, text and View All button as default content in the same section (section style split).
reuseGuidance: Reuse cards-product-tile wherever the same pattern appears (s4 (Best Of Apple): Apple product carousel (iPhone 18 Pro, AirPods 5, MacBook Pro, ...); s14 (Super Offers): Super offers product carousel). Section styles seen: split.
